# QuickView v6.52.4.0 Pre-Release

This pre-release consolidates major architecture modernizations, boot preloading, high-fidelity rendering pipeline upgrades, and experimental generative tools introduced since [v6.47.2.1](https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/releases/tag/v6.47.2.1).

---

### Important Notice: AI Action System (Highly Experimental)

> **Disclaimer**: The AI Action and Inpainting feature suite introduced in this version is a **highly experimental** feature. It is provided solely for technical evaluation, community testing, and feedback. Its protocols, interface bindings, and workflows are subject to major modifications, restructuring, or complete removal in future stable releases.

---

### What's Changed

#### 1. AI Actions & Interactive Inpainting (Experimental)
* **Interactive Generative Fill (Inpaint)**:
  * Added bounding box selection for local generative content replacement and fine-tuning.
  * Integrated feathered mask edge-blending algorithm for smooth, seamless region isolation and artifact-free composite transitions.
  * Simplified scope architecture to clean `FullImage` versus `CropAndBlend` modes.
* **Provider Routing & Dynamic Filtering**:
  * Native direct routing support for the Google Gemini API as well as standard OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
  * Added output resolution options for native 1K, 2K, and 4K generation.
  * Dynamically filters out unsupported parameters per backend provider (e.g., guidance scale).
* **AI Command Palette & Interaction Refinements**:
  * Added AI Command Palette supporting custom prompt templates and placeholder substitution.
  * Fixed custom prompts getting discarded when reselecting bounding boxes during Inpaint workflows.
  * Added dynamic card highlighting upon keystroke and enforced validations to block empty prompt submissions.
  * Added automatic window expansion and state restoration upon opening/closing overlay panels.
  * Integrated zero-cost vector-rendered 3-star sparkle icon via DirectWrite across context menus and settings, accompanied by full OSD localized notifications in 8 languages.

#### 2. Boot Performance & Startup Architecture
* **Asynchronous Boot Preloader**:
  * Introduced an asynchronous boot preloader integrated with direct DirectComposition presentation to eliminate blank launch windows and UI initialization flashing (#240).
  * Compute shaders are now compiled lazily on demand, preventing main thread stalls during cold startup (#240).
  * Early detection and handling for vertical and horizontal display orientations (#240).
  * Stripped and optimized embedded DXBC shader bytecodes to reduce cold-start I/O footprint.

#### 3. Rendering Pipeline & Color Management
* **Color Management Lookup Acceleration**:
  * Embedded color context lookups now utilize a flat hash cache and `std::unique_ptr<GamutProgram>`, eliminating redundant heap churn and expensive color transforms on critical rendering paths.
* **High-Quality Downsampling Pipeline**:
  * Integrated Bicubic Sharper downsampling with a dedicated deadband threshold to preserve line crispness and avoid aliasing when scaling images down (#144).
* **Smooth EXIF Hot-Navigation**:
  * Eliminated image flashing and visual tearing during rapid photo navigation by deferring view state resets and reordering the presentation pipeline.
* **Titan Gigapixel Engine Stability**:
  * Fixed concurrency deadlocks, memory race crashes, and UI freezes during heavy multithreaded tile decoding; added robust asynchronous cancellation (#249).
* **Vector Graphics Rasterization**:
  * Implemented adaptive raster scaling for small WMF and EMF vector files to maintain sharp line rendering (#144).

#### 4. Controls & Window Interaction
* **Zoom Centering & Window Sizing Polish**:
  * Fixed viewport center drift during continuous mouse wheel zooming (#234).
  * Resolved window border resizing jitter and redraw artifacts (#234).
* **Lock-Size & Viewport Tolerance**:
  * Tightened 100% 1:1 and fit-to-window calculation tolerances to eliminate false-positive lock-size triggers (#144).
* **UI Dialogs & Chrome Polish**:
  * Prevented premature text truncation in the Lite Info Panel when displaying long filenames (#234).
  * Standardized export and discard dialog prompts when navigating away from unsaved modifications.
  * Dismisses the full grid thumbnail gallery immediately upon selecting an item (#144).
  * Corrected context menu clipping, fixed phantom scroll indicators, aligned toggle switches, and removed unwanted dropdown shadows (#144).

#### 5. Zero-Cost Codebase Modernization & Cleanups
* **Removed STL Abstraction Overhead**:
  * Purged heap-allocating `std::function` closures across critical execution paths in favor of C-style function pointers and lightweight callbacks.
  * Unified string processing across the codebase via zero-allocation `StringUtils` routines.
* **Full Compiler Optimization Unleashed**:
  * Completely eliminated legacy `clang::minsize` and `noinline` attributes, allowing Clang-cl and Link-Time Optimization (LTO) to apply aggressive inlining and SIMD auto-vectorization across all translation units.
* **Super-Resolution Engine Enhancements**:
  * Added instant cache hot-switching and sub-pixel snapping under DirectComposition (#239).
* **Development Tooling**:
  * Added `.clangd` configuration for seamless Language Server Protocol support (#259).
  * Removed obsolete debug frame references (`g_animInspectorFrame`) (#258).
  * Fixed and polished the clean-clone build workflow for `cmake --preset Release-LTO` (#255).
